title: StashSyncStartedPayload
description: Payload for envelope.type === 'stash.sync.started'. STATE.md S8/K12 (Stash SQLite metadata sync, Lane C sync engine): emitted by apps/worker/src/stash/sync-consumer.ts when a `stash-sync` job (packages/jobs, StashSyncJobPayload) transitions to active, in the SAME transaction as the paired migrations/0020_stash_sync_reports.sql report row's creation. Paired with stash.sync.completed for the same jobId — mirrors scan.started/scan.completed's own pairing shape. A pg-boss RETRY of the same job (same jobId, resuming from apps/worker/src/stash/sync-consumer.ts's checkpoint) does not re-emit this event — only a genuinely fresh run (no prior checkpoint for this jobId) does, so one stash.sync.started never implies exactly one stash.sync.completed on a job that crashed and resumed. ADMIN-ONLY delivery: instance-configuration/operational bookkeeping about a metadata sync run, same posture as scan.started (not itself admin-only) elevated here because it names a specific library's Stash connection, matching stash.provider.disabled's own admin-only rationale.

jobId.description: The pg-boss job id (packages/jobs, meta.jobId) — pairs this event with its stash.sync.completed and with the migrations/0020 stash_sync_reports.job_id row.

libraryId.description: The library whose Stash connection this sync run is for.

mode.description: S8: 'full' walks every linked scene; 'incremental' diffs on Stash's updated_at columns and touches only changed/new/vanished scenes.
